name: Seamec Ltd
title: Seamec Ltd - 526807 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Seamec's FY26 record year (consol revenue Rs1,000cr, +47%; EBITDA Rs447cr) rests on DSV charters, but management guides ~15% FY27 growth with 40-42% margins, Paladin idle and no fleet capex beyond ANANT (~$70m).

utilisation.quote: the vessel utilization as such is almost 100%, barring off -hires

capex.peers_comment: Management said there are no new competitors and foreign owners are not keen on entering India; it is not chasing growth aggressively.
capex.quote: we are definitely not chasing the growth aggressively because these are all high CAPEX items

triggers.label: Vessel utilisation ~100%
triggers.quote: the vessel utilization as such is almost 100%, barring off -hires

triggers.label: Not chasing fleet growth aggressively
triggers.quote: we are definitely not chasing the growth aggressively because these are all high CAPEX items

triggers.label: Diamond rate ~$8,750/day; renewal +10-15%
triggers.quote: we are looking at an increase of maybe around 10% to 15%

triggers.label: FY27 growth ~15%, margin 40-42%
triggers.quote: we are expecting about 15% growth in top line and bottom line next year

triggers.label: Paladin idle in Dubai, Q4 and Q1 lost
triggers.quote: Seamec Paladin has not operated for Q4. And even Q1, we are not seeing the operations till date.

triggers.label: Rates a 'balanced' market, no tightening
triggers.quote: it is fairly balanced right now

guidance.quote: we are expecting about 15% growth in top line and bottom line next year
the margin should be in the range of 40% to 42%
the ANANT is roughly about $70 million, which is the scheduled CAPEX

red_flags.label: UK subsidiary impairment
red_flags.quote: we have just taken that impairment

red_flags.label: Paladin idle; geopolitical execution risk
red_flags.quote: prolonged instability or a broader regional conflict could affect contractual execution timelines

red_flags.label: Vague answer on margin and pricing
red_flags.quote: Sir, your assumption is not right and I would not like to comment further beyond 15%.

evasions.quote: I would not like to comment further beyond 15%
it is not that much buoyant
that is depending upon the transaction, and whatever is best for the stakeholder
